name: What common accessible home modifications are popular for aging in place?

mainEntity.name: What common accessible home modifications are popular for aging in place?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular accessible home modifications for aging in place include installing grab bars in bathrooms, adding walk-in or roll-in showers with seating, increasing lighting, and ensuring slip-resistant flooring. Other common changes involve widening doorways, replacing traditional doorknobs with lever-style handles, and lowering light switches or raising electrical outlets. These modifications enhance safety and comfort, helping individuals maintain independence in their homes as they age, reducing the risk of falls and making daily tasks more manageable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular accessible modifications for aging in place include grab bars, walk-in showers, wider doorways, and lever handles to enhance safety and independence.
